y-m-35-05.goal: Ka sabunta tabbacin “mai yiwuwa/ba zai yiwu ba” a hankali ta amfani da tebur da gwaje-gwaje da tsawon adadi goma, sannan ka bincika da furuci (determinant) sharadin samun lambobi biyu na gaske masu jimilla da ninkin da aka bayar.
y-m-35-05.material: Kana son mai da lambun makaranta murabba’i mai gefuna huɗu. Ka yi amfani da duk shingen mita 10 ka zagaya lambun sau ɗaya. Idan faɗi x m ne kuma tsawo y m ne, to x + y = 5 (x da y lambobi ne na gaske sama da 0, tsawo kuma na iya zama adadi goma). Ana bayyana bayanin mataki-mataki.

y-m-35-05.thinking.1: Juya sharuddan jimilla da ninkin zuwa ma’aunin murabba’i

y-m-35-05.s.s1.prompt: Duba bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka sabunta hukuncinka kan “Za mu iya yin lambun da fili daidai 7 m²?”
y-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta lambobin tebur daga sama zuwa ƙasa ka rubuta da kalmomi yadda filin yake canjawa.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.1: A duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya zo, bambanta ko hukuncinka na farko ya tsaya yadda yake ko kuma matakin tabbaci ne kawai ya canja.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.info: [Mataki na 1] Ka gwada faɗi da lambobin halitta. Faɗi 1 m da tsawo 4 m suna ba da fili 4 m². Faɗi 2 m da tsawo 3 m suna ba da 6 m². Faɗi 3 m da tsawo 2 m suna ba da 6 m². Faɗi 4 m da tsawo 1 m suna ba da 4 m².
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Za a iya cewa za a iya samun fili 7 m²?
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Faɗin da ke tebur duk lambobin halitta ne, saboda haka babu abin da ke tsakanin 2 da 3. “Ba a sani ba tukuna” da “watakila yana da wuya” duka hukunci ne da za ka iya yi bisa wannan bayanin.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yana yiwuwa — bayan 6 akwai 7, saboda haka kawai mu ɗan canja faɗin
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Teburin ya tsaya a 6 sannan ya ragu, amma ya ɗauka cewa ƙimar za ta ci gaba da ƙaruwa ne kawai.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba za a iya tantancewa tukuna ba — dole ne mu gwada tsawon adadi goma tsakanin 2 da 3
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba zai yiwu ba — ba a samu 7 da tsawon lambobin halitta ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: An gwada tsawon lambobin halitta kawai amma aka ɗauka cewa hakan ya shafi komai har da tsawon adadi goma.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Da alama ba zai yiwu ba amma ba a tabbatar ba — mafi girman ƙimar tana kama da kusan 6
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.info: [Mataki na 2] Ka kuma gwada tsawon adadi goma. Faɗi 2.2 m da tsawo 2.8 m suna ba da fili 6.16 m². Faɗi 2.4 m da tsawo 2.6 m suna ba da 6.24 m². Faɗi 2.5 m da tsawo 2.5 m suna ba da 6.25 m². Faɗi 2.6 m da tsawo 2.4 m suna ba da 6.24 m².
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 6.25 m² a faɗin 2.5 m ya yi kama da mafi girma, kuma yana raguwa a ɓangarorin biyu. Saboda haka tabbacin ka cewa “mai yiwuwa ba zai yiwu ba” ya ƙaru. Amma tebur kaɗai ba hujja ba ne, don haka a ƙarshe ana buƙatar furuci.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: An tabbatar ba zai yiwu ba — domin 7 bai taɓa bayyana a tebur ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tebur yana da ƙididdiga iyakantattu. Rashin kasancewa a tebur ba hujja ba ne.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yana yiwuwa — 6.25 ya fi 6, don haka idan muka ci gaba da ƙara zai kai 7
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ba a lura cewa filin yana sake raguwa bayan wucewa kusa da faɗin 2.5 ba.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Wataƙila ba zai yiwu ba — yana kama da ya fi yawa a 2.5 amma ba a bincika komai ba tukuna
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Har yanzu ba za a iya sanin komai ba — ko da tebur ya ƙaru, hukuncin bai canja ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ba a nuna tasirin sabon bayanin ga matakin tabbaci ba.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.info: [Mataki na 3] Mu bincika da furuci. Tsawon shi ne y = 5 − x, saboda haka x(5 − x) = 7, wato x² − 5x + 7 = 0. Determinant ɗin shi ne (−5)² − 4·1·7 = −3. Haka kuma x(5 − x) = 6.25 − (x − 2.5)², don haka filin ba zai wuce 6.25 m² ba.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wane ne ƙarshen da ya dace?
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Don samun fili k m², x² − 5x + k = 0 dole ya sami tushe na gaske mai kyau, kuma hakan yana yiwuwa idan determinant 25 − 4k ≥ 0 ne, wato k ≤ 6.25.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 7 m² yana yiwuwa, amma faɗin yana zama na zato saboda haka ba za a iya yin sa a zahiri ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: An gauraya tsawon zato da “mai yiwuwa amma ba za a iya yin sa ba”. A nan tsawo dole ya zama na gaske, saboda haka ba zai yiwu ba.

y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: An riga an yi 6 m² a tebur. Determinant ɗin furucin ne idan an sa filin ya zama 7.
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 7 m² ba zai yiwu ba. Yana yiwuwa ne kawai idan filin bai wuce 6.25 m² ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 7 m² ba zai yiwu ba, amma dalili shi ne ba a ga 7 a tebur ba
y-m-35-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ƙarshen daidai ne, amma dalilin shi ne gibin tebur. Furuci (determinant, mafi girman ƙima) ne ke ba da dalili.

y-m-35-04.topic: Ƙayyade ƙididdigogi daga mafitar rashin daidaiton murabba’i: tazarar mafita da alamar ƙididdigar farko
y-m-35-04.goal: Daga tazarar mafita ta rashin daidaiton murabba’i, ƙirƙiri wasu yiwuwar saitin ƙididdigogi, sannan bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba a ƙayyade ƙididdigogin guda ɗaya ba da kuma abin da ya kamata a sani ƙari.
y-m-35-04.material: A ce mafitar rashin daidaiton murabba’i ax² + bx + c > 0 (a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne, a ≠ 0) ita ce −1 < x < 2. Ma’ana: “a x murabba’i da b x da c sun fi sifili. y-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta furucin gefen hagu na kowane zaɓi da (x + 1)(x − 2), sannan nemo daidaitattun x na wuraren da jadawalin ya haɗu da x-axis.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Duba alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito tare da alamar ƙididdigar farko, ka tantance ko tazarar ce jadawalin yake sama ko ƙasa da x-axis.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.r.a: Tushen −1 da 2 daidai ne, amma ga jadawalin da yake buɗewa sama, > 0 yana wajen tazarar (x < −1 ko x > 2).
y-m-35-04.s.s1.r.b: Tushen su ne −2 da 1, ba −1 da 2 ba. An karanta alamun ninkin da jimilla a baya.
y-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: x² − x − 2 = (x + 1)(x − 2), kuma tazarar da wannan furuci yake ƙasa da 0 ita ce −1 < x < 2. c shi ne yanayin da furucin mai alamun akasin haka ya fi 0, d shi ne yanayin da ninki biyu na furucin ya gaza 0, e kuma shi ne yanayin da −3 ninkin furucin ya fi 0. a shi ne x < −1 ko x > 2, b kuma shi ne −2 < x < 1.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri wasu uku-uku na lambobi cikakku (a, b, c), masu a daban-daban, ta yadda mafitar ax² + bx + c > 0 daidai take −1 < x < 2.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kamar yadda ka gani a zaɓuɓɓukan c da e, lura cewa kowannensu wannan rashin daidaito ne da aka ninka dukkan ƙididdigoginsa da wani adadi. Alamar adadin da aka ninka da shi ce ke yanke mafita.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Saka (a, b, c) ɗin da ka ƙirƙira a cikin ax² + bx + c > 0, sannan gwada ƙimomi a ciki da wajen tazarar mafita kamar x = 0 da x = 3.

y-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Tazarar da > 0 yake cikinta ita ce tsakanin tushen biyun.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Tare da waɗannan alamun ƙididdiga, mafitar > 0 ba tsakanin tushen take ba, tana wajensu. Duba ko jadawalin yana buɗewa sama ko ƙasa.
y-m-35-04.s.s2.explain: a(x + 1)(x − 2) = ax² − ax − 2a, saboda haka b = −a da c = −2a. Don mafitar > 0 ta kasance tsakanin tushen biyu, jadawalin dole ya buɗe ƙasa, ba sama ba; wato a < 0. (−1, 1, 2), (−2, 2, 4), (−3, 3, 6) da makamantansu duk amsoshi ne.
y-m-35-04.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta dalilin da ya sa ba a ƙayyade (a, b, c) guda ɗaya ba, sannan ba da misalin bayani guda ɗaya da ya dace a ƙara.
y-m-35-04.s.s3.hint.0: A jera uku-uku (a, b, c) ɗin da ka samo gefe da gefe, sannan ka kwatanta dangantakarsu.
y-m-35-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kafa ƙarin bayani guda ɗaya (misali, ƙimar wani ƙididdiga) sannan ka tabbatar ko uku-ukun sun zama guda ɗaya.

Ko da an ninka dukkan ƙididdigogi da lamba mara kyau iri ɗaya, mafitar iri ɗaya ce. Misali, idan aka bayar cewa ƙididdigar farko −2 ce, to an ƙayyade b = 2 da c = 4.

y-m-35-01.title: |x−2|=2x−7: Amsoshin dalibai biyu sun bambanta
y-m-35-01.topic: Daidaito tare da cikakkun ƙima: duba ko ƴan takara a kowane hali sun kiyaye yanayin wannan harka
y-m-35-01.goal: Don ma'auni tare da cikakkiyar ƙima, yi hukunci tare da dalilan wanne daga cikin ƴan takarar da aka samu ta hanyar rarrabuwar kawuna shine mafita, kuma ku tsara ma kanku ma'auni inda aka jefar da ɗan takara.
y-m-35-01.material:
Dalibai biyu sun warware ma'auni |x - 2| = 2x - 7 (x adadi ne na gaske). Yadda ake karantawa: '|x − 2| = 2x - 7' shine 'cikakkiyar ƙimar x debe 2 daidai da 2x a debe 7'. Duk daliban biyu sun fara ta hanyar rarraba zuwa 'lokacin x ≥ 2' da 'lokacin x <2'.
· Lokacin x ≥ 2: daga x - 2 = 2x - 7, x = 5 ya fito.
· Lokacin x <2: daga -(x - 2) = 2x - 7, x = 3 ya fito.
Dalibi ya amsa 'x = 3 ko x = 5', kuma dalibi ya amsa 'x = 5'. 가 나

y-m-35-01.s.s1.explain: x = 3 dan takara ne daga shari'ar x <2, amma 3 bai gaza 2 ba, don haka ba shine mafita ga wannan lamarin ba. Toshe shi cikin ainihin ma'auni kuma yana bada |3 - 2| = 1 da 2 · 3 - 7 = -1, wadanda ba daidai ba ne. x = 5 ya gamsar da 5 ≥ 2, da |5 - 2| = 3 = 2 · 5 - 7, don haka shine mafita. y-m-35-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Maganin ma'auni x - a = 2x - c na shari'ar x ≥ a ba 5. Magance wannan lissafin da kanka.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Dan takara a cikin shari'ar x <a bai gaza a (ba shi da iyaka), don haka an jefar da shi.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Dan takarar da ke cikin shari'ar x <a ya faɗi cikin kewayon shari'ar (x <a). Yi lissafin ɗan takarar kuma kwatanta shi da a.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.explain: A cikin yanayin x ≥ a, x = c - a, don haka c - a dole ne ya zama 5. Idan ɗan takara (a + c) / 3 a cikin harka x <a bai kasa da a ba, ɗan takarar yana waje da kewayon x <a kuma an jefar dashi. Idan c = a + 5, wannan yanayin daidai yake da ≤ 5. Misalai: (a, c) = (1, 6), (2, 7), (3, 8), (4, 9), (5, 10). A (5, 10), dan takarar yana da 5, daidai da iyaka, don haka bai gamsar da x <5 ba kuma an jefar da shi, kuma kawai mafita shine x = 5. Don (6, 11), a cikin yanayin x 6, 5 ba ya da iyaka, don haka mafita ba 5 ba.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Domin magana ɗaya da kuka zaɓa, rubuta a cikin jumla ɗaya ko biyu, tare da ainihin lambobi a ciki, dalilin da yasa aka jefar da ɗan takarar da aka samu daga shari'ar x <a.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tare da a da c da kuka zaɓa, warware lissafin -(x - a) = 2x - c na shari'ar x <a kuma nemo ɗan takara.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta ɗan takarar tare da yanayin yanayin x <a, sannan kuma toshe shi cikin ɓangarorin asali na asali.

y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin kun nuna ta kwatancen cewa ɗan takarar ya karya yanayin shari'ar (ko kuma ya nuna cewa bangarorin biyu sun bambanta lokacin da aka toshe cikin ainihin ma'auni)?
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Shin kun rubuta sharadin da ya zama dalilin jefar da shi, ba wai kawai 'saboda ba daidai ba'?
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Misali, idan a = 2 da c = 7, dan takara x = 3 ya fito a cikin shari'ar x <2. 3 bai gamsar da x <2 ba, don haka mu watsar da shi. Toshe shi cikin ainihin ma'auni kuma yana bada |3 - 2| = 1 da 2 · 3 - 7 = -1, don haka bangarorin biyu sun bambanta.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Lokacin da a = 1 da c = 6, ɗan takara a cikin akwati x <1 shine x = 7/3, amma wannan darajar ta fi 1 girma, don haka yana waje da kewayon yanayin. Sauyawa, gefen hagu shine 4/3 kuma gefen dama shine -4/3, don haka ko da alamun sun bambanta.

y-m-35-02.title: Tushen ainihin ma'auni mai ƙunshe da m, yayin da ake ƙara yanayi ɗaya bayan ɗaya
y-m-35-02.topic: Bambance-bambancen ma'auni mai ma'auni da ƙididdiga na haruffa: shari'ar inda babban haɗin kai shine 0 da fassarar yanayin matsalar.
y-m-35-02.goal: Don ma'auni tare da wasiƙa a cikin ƙididdiga, duba wane nau'in furci ne kafin amfani da nuna bambanci, kuma yanke hukunci yadda kewayon amsar ke canzawa lokacin da yanayin matsalar ya canza.
y-m-35-02.material: m na gaske ne, kuma muna tunanin ainihin tushen (tushen da suke ainihin lambobi) na furcin mx² - 2x + 1 = 0 a x. Yadda ake karantawa: 'm x squared debe 2x da 1 daidai sifili'. Bambancin ma'auni na ma'auni ax² + bx + c = 0 shine D = b² - 4ac, kuma a nan b ma yake, don haka kuna iya lissafin D/4 = (-1)² - m·1 = 1 - m. An bayyana jimlar matsalar kaɗan kaɗan a kowane mataki.
y-m-35-02.thinking.0: Tsayawa ko sake duba hukuncinku na farko dangane da sabon yanayi
y-m-35-02.thinking.1: Duba yanayin da za a iya amfani da mai wariya a ƙarƙashinsa (ko furci huɗu ne)
y-m-35-02.thinking.2: Da yake bayyana cewa ko da magana iri ɗaya yana ba da amsoshi daban-daban dangane da yanayin
y-m-35-02.prereq.0: Dangantakar da ke tsakanin mai wariya D = b² - 4ac na ma'auni quadratic ax² + bx + c = 0 da adadin ainihin tushen.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.prompt: An bayyana jumlar matsalar mataki-mataki. A kowane mataki, zaɓi kewayon da ya dace.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.0: Toshe takamaiman lambobi (misali 1, 2, 0) a cikin m, warware lissafin kai tsaye, kuma tsara a cikin tebur ko akwai tushen gaske.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.1: A kowane mataki, rubuta a layi ɗaya abin da yanayin ya canza, kuma duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko amsar matakin farko ta kasance iri ɗaya.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.info: [Mataki na 1] Matsala: 'Lokacin da lissafin mx² - 2x + 1 = 0 a x yana da tushe na gaske, menene kewayon ainihin lambar m?' (Kalmar 'quadratic equation' ba ta nan.) Kun sami bambance-bambancen D/4 = 1 - m.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Menene kewayon mafi dacewa ga m?
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Jumlar ba ta ƙunshi kalmomin 'equation quadrate' ba, don haka m = 0 (kalmar ta zama -2x + 1 = 0 da x = 1/2 shine tushen) kuma an yarda. Don haka m ≤ 1 ita ce amsar da ta dace na wannan jumla. Yana da kyau a lura, ko da yake, m = 0 shine yanayin da lissafin nuna bambanci ba ya aiki.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: m <1 - akwai ainihin tushen kawai lokacin da mai nuna bambanci ya kasance tabbatacce
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokacin D = 0 (tushen biyu) akwai kuma tushen gaske guda ɗaya, amma an bar shi.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: m ≤ 1 - akwai ainihin tushen idan mai nuna bambanci ya kasance 0 ko fiye
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ya karanta D ≥ 0 kamar yadda yake. Cewa furcin ya canza idan m = 0 ba a bincika ba tukuna.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: m ≥ 1 - ɗaukar alamar rashin daidaituwa na 1 - m ≥ 0 kamar yadda yake.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: An rubuta jagorancin alamar rashin daidaituwa a baya. Kuna iya ganowa ta hanyar warware D/4 = 1 - m ≥ 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: m ≤ 1 shine ainihin amsar, amma ina so in bincika daban ko magana ta canza lokacin da m = 0
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ya fara zargin al'amarin da irin yanayin magana ke canzawa.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.info: [Mataki na 2] An sake bitar matsalar: 'Lokacin da ma'auni na quadratic mx² - 2x + 1 = 0 a x yana da tushe na gaske, menene kewayon ainihin lambar m?'
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan ma'aunin 'quadratic equation' ne, ana buƙatar m ≠ 0. Don haka m ≤ 1 da m ≠ 0. Amsar mataki na 1 ba za a iya amfani da shi ba kamar yadda yake ga wannan jumla.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Bai nuna cewa 'quadratic' ya fito ba. Don ma'auni huɗu, kuna buƙatar bincika ko m = 0 zai yiwu.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ya karanta yanayin samun tushen asali a matsayin 'tushen gaske guda biyu daban-daban'. Tushen biyu tare da D = 0 shima tushen gaske ne.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ya kara da yanayin cewa, saboda ma'auni ne na hudu, babban ma'aunin ƙima dole ne ya zama 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: An ɗauka cewa m dole ne ya zama tabbatacce. Idan ka toshe m = -1, -x² - 2x + 1 = 0 kuma yana da tushe na gaske.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.info: [Mataki na 3] Matsalar ta sake canzawa: 'Lokacin da ma'aunin ma'auni mx² - 2x + 1 = 0 a x yana da tushen asali guda biyu daban-daban, menene kewayon ainihin lambar m?'
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: A wannan lokacin, menene kewayon m?
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Don tushen asali guda biyu daban-daban, D> 0, kuma shi ne ma'auni mai ma'auni don haka m ≠ 0. So m <1 da m ≠ 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ya manta da yanayin cewa shi ne ma'auni na huɗu (m ≠ 0).
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: D = 0 ba saiwoyi daban-daban ba ne amma saiwoyin biyu (tushe daya), duk da haka an haɗa shi.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan ita ce gefen da D <0. A wannan yanayin babu tushen asali.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.reflect: Idan ka zaɓi 'm ≤ 1' a mataki na 1, wannan hukuncin yayi daidai da wancan jumlar. Amma a mataki na 2 yanayin ya canza kuma amsar wannan magana ta canza. Nemo lokacin da al'adar dubawa 'wannan magana da gaske tana da mutuƙar mutu'a?' kafin amfani da nuna bambanci ya daidaita hukuncin ku.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta dalilin da yasa kake buƙatar duba harka m = 0 daban, da kuma misalin yadda amsar ta bambanta dangane da jimlar matsalar koda da magana iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta abin da kuke samu ta hanyar toshe m = 0 cikin mx² - 2x + 1 = 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.1: A warware wannan furcin don ganin ko yana da tushe na gaske, kuma kwatanta yanayin inda matsalar ta ce 'quadratic equation' da yanayin inda kawai ta ce 'equation'.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin kun warware magana tare da m = 0 da kanku kuma kun tabbatar da cewa yana da tushe?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin kun rubuta daidai yadda amsar ta bambanta lokacin da kalmomin 'quadratic equation' suke wurin da kuma lokacin da babu su?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin kun yi tunanin wace irin magana ce wariya kayan aiki ne?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.model.0: Idan m = 0, kalmar quadratic ta ɓace kuma ya zama ma'auni na layi -2x + 1 = 0, kuma x = 1/2 tushen gaske ne. Idan matsalar ta ce 'quadratic equation', amsar ita ce m ≤ 1, m ≠ 0, barin m = 0, kuma idan kawai ta ce 'equation', amsar ita ce m ≤ 1, ciki har da m = 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.model.1: Ƙimar wariya kayan aiki ne da ake amfani da shi kawai don ma'auni huɗu, don haka m = 0 ana duba shi daban. Idan m = 0, shine -2x + 1 = 0 kuma x = 0.5 shine tushen. Don haka ya danganta ko jumlar tana da 'quadratic', ta rabu zuwa m ≤ 1 ko 'm ≤ 1 da m ≠ 0'.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsar da ke aiki da abun ciki iri ɗaya ta amfani da ƙima

y-m-35-03.title: Shin alama ɗaya ce cewa jimlar murabba'in tushen biyu ya isa 10?
y-m-35-03.topic: Dangantaka tsakanin tushen da ma'auni: an ƙayyade ƙididdiga yayin da kawai aka san jimlar murabba'in tushen biyu?
y-m-35-03.goal: Juya yanayin zuwa magana a cikin ƙididdiga ta amfani da alaƙa tsakanin tushen da ƙididdiga, sannan yanke hukunci ko wannan yanayin shi kaɗai ya ƙayyade ƙididdiga kuma faɗi abin da ake buƙata.
y-m-35-03.material: p da q lambobi ne na gaske, kuma tushen biyu na ma'auni huɗun x² + px + q = 0 a x lambobin gaske ne α da β. (Yadda ake karantawa: 'x squared plus p x plus q daidai sifili'.) Abin da muka sani kawai shine α² + β² = 10 (alpha squared da beta squared goma ne).
y-m-35-03.thinking.1: Yin misalai da yawa waɗanda suka gamsar da yanayin da kuma bincika yanayin tushen ainihin
y-m-35-03.thinking.2: Gwaji ko ƙarin bayani yana ƙayyadadden ƙididdiga a matsayin ɗaya
y-m-35-03.prereq.0: Dangantaka tsakanin tushen da ma'auni na ma'auni huɗu: jimlar tushen biyu = - (ƙirar x), samfur = madaidaicin lokaci (lokacin da adadin x² ya kasance 1)
y-m-35-03.prereq.1: The nuna bambanci da ainihin tushen
y-m-35-03.s.s1.prompt: Me zai faru (p, q) tare da wannan alamar ita kaɗai?
y-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta α + β da αβ cikin sharuddan p da q, sannan a sake rubuta α² + β² ta amfani da (α + β)² da αβ.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙidaya adadin ma'auni tsakanin p da q sakamakon, kuma nemo ta hanyar maye gurbin ɗaya bayan ɗaya (p, q) waɗanda suka gamsar da wannan ma'auni.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.a: An ƙaddara a matsayin ɗaya - tare da alamar, p da q kowanne yana fitowa a matsayin ƙima ɗaya
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.a: An zaci cewa ƙila ɗaya na iya tantance abubuwan da ba a sani ba guda biyu.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.b: Ba a ƙayyade ba - ana iya samun nau'i-nau'i da yawa (p, q) waɗanda suka gamsar da alamar
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya yin hukunci ba - ba za mu iya sanin ko tushen gaskiya ne ba, don haka ba za a iya cewa komai ba
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.c: Kayan ya ce tushen gaskiya ne. Ya rasa yanayin da aka bayar.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.d: p² an ƙaddara kuma q kawai yana da kyauta - saboda p² shine 10
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.d: A cikin kalmar α² + β² = p² - 2q, bai ga rabon q ba.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.explain: α + β = -p da αβ = q, haka α² + β² = (α + β)² - 2αβ = p² - 2q. Ma'anar ita ce kawai daidaito guda p² - 2q = 10, don haka nau'i-nau'i da yawa suna yiwuwa, kamar (p, q) = (4, 3), (2, -3), (0, -5) (ka kuma buƙatar duba cewa tushen gaskiya ne).
y-m-35-03.s.s2.prompt: Yi nau'i-nau'i daban-daban guda uku (p, q) waɗanda ke gamsar da alamar α² + β² = 10 kuma waɗanda tushensu biyu na gaske ne, a yanayin da p da q duka lamba ne.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.0: Yin amfani da alamar da aka rubuta azaman equation a p da q, lissafta yadda q ke ƙayyade da zarar kun gyara p.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane nau'i-nau'i da kuka samo, ƙididdige alamar p² - 4q don bincika cewa tushen gaskiya ne.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a zaɓi p da q a matsayin lamba.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c2: α² + β² ba ya zama 10. Yi lissafi ta amfani da α + β = −p da αβ = q.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Tushen biyu lambobi ne na gaske.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Determinant ɗin ya zama mara kyau, saboda haka tushen biyun ba lambobi ne na gaske ba.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.explain: Haɗin lambobi cikakku da suka cika p² − 2q = 10 da p² − 4q ≥ 0 su ne (±4, 3), (±2, −3), (0, −5). (6, 13) yana cika p² − 2q = 10, amma determinant ɗinsa 36 − 52 < 0 ne, saboda haka tushen su ne 3 ± 2i (lambobin zato). Ko da α² + β² = 10 ya cika da tushen zato, sharadin cewa “tushen lambobi ne na gaske” ya karye.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.prompt: Idan p da q lambobi ne na gaske, zaɓi duk zaɓuɓɓukan da ƙara ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ga bayanin α² + β² = 10 kaɗai zai ƙayyade (p, q) guda ɗaya.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.0: A kowane zaɓi, haɗa shi da p² − 2q = 10, nemo p ko q, sannan ƙirga yawan amsoshin da aka samu.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ga zaɓin da ya ba da amsoshi biyu ko fiye, kuma bincika ko kowannensu ya cika sharadin determinant p² − 4q ≥ 0.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.a: Idan q = 3, to p² = 16, saboda haka p = 4 da p = −4 duka suna yiwuwa. Ko da ninkin ya zama ɗaya, alamar p har yanzu ba a sani ba.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.o.c: Ɗaya daga cikin tushen biyun 1 ne
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.c: Haɗa ma’aunin da aka samu ta saka 1 da bayanin yana ba da yiwuwar (p, q) biyu. Yana da sauƙi a yi tunanin cewa sanin tushe ɗaya ya isa.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.e: Sharadin alama yana taƙaita kewayon ne kawai, ba ya ƙayyade ƙima guda ɗaya. Har yanzu akwai lambobin p na gaske marasa iyaka.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.explain: Idan jimillar −2 ce, an ƙayyade p = 2 da q = (4 − 10)/2 = −3. Idan ninkin −5 ne, p² = 0, saboda haka an ƙayyade p = 0. Idan ninkin 3 ne, akwai haɗe-haɗe biyu, (4, 3) da (−4, 3); idan kuma ɗaya daga tushen 1 ne, akwai (2, −3) da (−4, 3). Idan tushen biyun tabbatattu ne, ga kowace p ta gaske inda −2√5 ≤ p < −√10 akwai q = (p² − 10)/2, saboda haka akwai marasa iyaka.

y-m-35-08.title: Ma’aunai nawa ne na digiri uku suke da tushen 1 da 2?
y-m-35-08.topic: Ma’aunai na digiri uku: dangantakar tushe na ukun da ya rage da ƙididdigogi idan an bayar da tushen biyu
y-m-35-08.goal: Ka bincika ta hanyar ƙirƙirar misalai cewa idan an bayar da tushen biyu na ma’aunin digiri uku kawai, ba a ƙayyade ƙididdigogi guda ɗaya ba, kuma tushen da ya rage ne ke yanke ƙididdigogin.
y-m-35-08.material: a, b, da c lambobi cikakku ne, kuma a sa f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx + c. Ma’ana: “x kubu da a x murabba’i da b x da c.” Abin da ka sani kawai shi ne tushe ɗaya na ma’aunin f(x) = 0 shi ne 1, wani kuma 2 (ba ka san tushen na uku ba).

y-m-35-08.thinking.2: Gano ƙa’ida daga misalai (dangantakar tushen na uku da a)

y-m-35-08.s.s1.r.b: Gaskiya ne jimillar ita ce −a, amma idan ba ka san tushen na uku ba, ba ka san jimillar ma ba.

y-m-35-08.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri wasu uku (a, b, c), masu a daban-daban, na ma’aunai masu tushen lambobi cikakku tabbatattu daban-daban guda uku, biyu daga cikinsu 1 da 2 ne.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka sa tushen na uku ya zama lamba cikakkiya 3 ko fiye, sannan faɗaɗa (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − lambar da ka zaɓa) ka karanta ƙididdigogin.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.hint.1: Maimakon faɗaɗawa, za ka iya kuma warware ma’aunai biyu f(1) = 0 da f(2) = 0. Bincika cewa tushen na uku lamba cikakkiya tabbatacciya ce daban da gaske.

y-m-35-08.s.s2.explain: Idan tushen na uku r ne, to f(x) = (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − r), kuma a = −(3 + r), b = 2 + 3r, c = −2r. Idan r = 3, 4, 5, 6, to (a, b, c) = (−6, 11, −6), (−7, 14, −8), (−8, 17, −10), (−9, 20, −12). y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan a ya ragu da mataki ɗaya, tushen na uku yana ƙaruwa da 1. Idan a = −6 tushen 3 ne, idan a = −8 kuma 5 ne.

y-m-35-06.title: Duba mafitar da ta ƙare da cewa “babu mafita”
y-m-35-06.topic: Ma’aunai masu digiri mafi girma: sharadin rashin rasa mafita idan furuci iri ɗaya yana ɓangarorin biyu
y-m-35-06.goal: Ga ma’aunin da ke da furuci iri ɗaya a ɓangarorin biyu, nemo inda kuskuren warwarewa ya fara, tantance a waɗanne yanayi ba a rasa mafita, sannan ƙirƙiri ma’aunin da ake rasa mafita a ciki.
y-m-35-06.material: Wannan ita ce warwarewar ɗalibi ga ma’aunin (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1) (x lamba ce ta gaske). Ma’ana: “(x − 3)(x + 2) daidai yake da (x − 3)(x + 1)”.
y-m-35-06.thinking.0: Nemo wurin kuskuren warwarewa kuma ka gyara shi
y-m-35-06.thinking.1: Tantance sharadin da zai ba ka damar soke furuci iri ɗaya
y-m-35-06.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri ma’aunin misali mai nuna kuskuren
y-m-35-06.prereq.0: Rarraba zuwa masu ninkawa da sharadin da ninki zai zama 0
y-m-35-06.prereq.1: Faɗaɗa furucin polynomial da warware ma’aunin layi
y-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a wannan warwarewa da matsala ta fara bayyana.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta irin lissafin da aka yi a kowane layi daga layin da ya gabata, sannan ka duba ko ana iya yin wannan lissafin ga kowace lamba ta gaske x.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunani ko furucin da aka yi amfani da shi a layin da ake zargi zai iya zama 0; idan akwai irin wannan x, saka shi kai tsaye cikin ma’aunin asali ka ƙididdige ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.0: A cikin (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1), furuci iri ɗaya (x − 3) yana ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.1: Raba ɓangarorin biyu da (x − 3) yana ba da x + 2 = x + 1.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.2: Idan aka sauƙaƙa, ana samun 2 = 1, saboda haka ma’aunin ba ya cika.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka wannan ma’auni ba shi da mafita.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: A layi na 2, an raba ɓangarorin biyu da x − 3, amma idan x = 3, to x − 3 = 0 kuma ba za a iya raba da 0 ba. Ba a bincika wannan yanayin dabam ba, saboda haka ƙarshen “babu mafita” a layi na 4 ma kuskure ne (layi na 4 ba wurin da matsalar ta fara ba ne, sakamakon matsalar ne). A zahiri, idan aka saka x = 3, ɓangarorin biyu 0 ne, saboda haka x = 3 mafita ce.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Don kauce wa rasa mafita yayin hanyar raba furuci iri ɗaya (x − 3) a ɓangarorin biyu, wanne daga cikin waɗannan zai taimaka? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fara neman duk x da ke sa abin da ake rabawa da shi ya zama 0, sannan ka duba abin da ke faruwa idan ka saka wannan ƙima cikin ma’aunin asali.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: A kowane zaɓi, yi tunani ko har yanzu akwai “x da za a iya rasa a matsayin mafita”.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.a: Idan furuci iri ɗaya yana ɓangarorin biyu, za a iya raba shi a kowane lokaci, saboda haka ka raba nan take
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.a: Ba a lura cewa ba za a iya rabawa a ƙimomin da ke sa abin da ake rabawa da shi ya zama 0 ba.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.b: Saka ƙimomin x da ke sa abin da ake rabawa da shi ya zama 0 dabam cikin ma’aunin asali, sannan ka bincika ko mafita ne
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.c: Idan bayan rabuwa an samu karo da juna (2 = 1), ɗauka cewa ma’aunin asali ma ya saɓa wa juna
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.c: Ma’aunin da aka raba da shi da na asali ba lallai su zama ma’auni iri ɗaya ba. Karon juna sakamakon ma’aunin da aka raba ne kawai.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.d: Raba ne kawai idan abin da ake rabawa da shi ba zai taɓa zama 0 ga kowace lamba ta gaske ba (misali, x² + 1)
y-m-35-06.s.s2.explain: Idan babu x da ke sa abin da ake rabawa da shi ya zama 0 (d), rabuwa ba ta rasa mafita. Idan akwai x da ke sa ya zama 0, dole ne a saka wannan ƙimar dabam cikin ma’aunin asali a bincika (b). Don warwarewa gaba ɗaya, akwai kuma hanyar matsar da komai gefe ɗaya sannan a rarraba zuwa masu ninkawa (ninkin ya zama 0).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.prompt: A cikin sifar (x − a)(x + b) = (x − a)(2x + c), inda a, b, c lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9, ƙirƙiri wasu uku (a, b, c) masu a daban-daban, na ma’aunai masu haɗin mafita daban-daban, inda ɗalibin da ya raba ɓangarorin biyu da (x − a) zai rasa mafita ɗaya (mafitar ƙimomi biyu daban-daban ce).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.0: Haɗa ɓangarorin biyu a gefe ɗaya, rarraba ta hanyar fitar da (x − a), sannan nemo x da ke sa sauran furucin ya zama 0.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.1: Idan wannan x ya yi daidai da a, mafita guda ɗaya ce kawai; don haka zaɓi b da c ta yadda ya bambanta da a.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.ok.c1: Lambobi ukun lambobi cikakku ne da ke cikin kewayon.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.fail.c1: Zaɓi a, b, c a matsayin lambobi cikakku daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Mafita guda ɗaya ce kawai. Bayan rarraba ta hanyar fitar da (x − a), mafitar sauran furucin dole ta bambanta da a.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x + b) − (x − a)(2x + c) = (x − a)(b − c − x), saboda haka mafitar su ne x = a da x = b − c. Idan a ≠ b − c akwai mafita biyu, amma raba ta da (x − a) yana ba da x = b − c kawai. Misali: (3, 2, 1) → mafita 3, 1. Misalan da ke da haɗin (a, b − c) iri ɗaya ana ƙirga su ɗaya.

y-m-35-07.title: Idan determinant mara kyau ne, shin kullum yana da kyau? Kwatanta mafita biyu
y-m-35-07.topic: Sharadin da rashin daidaiton murabba’i zai cika ga duk lambobin gaske: determinant da alamar ƙididdigar farko
y-m-35-07.goal: Kwatanta kuma tantance mafita biyu game da sharadin da zai sa furucin murabba’i ya tabbata ga duk lambobin gaske; nuna kuskuren mafita ɗaya da misalin da ya ƙaryata ta, sannan rubuta cikakken sharadin.
y-m-35-07.material:
k ƙayyadadden lamba ce ta gaske, kuma tambayar ita ce “Nemo kewayon k da zai sa rashin daidaiton kx² − 4x + k > 0 ya cika ga duk x na gaske.” Ma’ana: “k x murabba’i a cire 4x a ƙara k ya fi 0.”
Mafita A: Don jadawalin ya kasance kullum sama da x-axis, kada ya haɗu da x-axis; saboda haka D/4 = 4 − k² < 0, wato k² > 4. Saboda haka k > 2 ko k < −2.
Mafita B: Daga k > 2 ko k < −2 da aka samu a A, jadawalin dole ya kasance a sama, saboda haka ana kuma buƙatar k > 0. Saboda haka k > 2.
y-m-35-07.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalin da zai nuna kuskuren yin ƙa’ida gaba ɗaya
y-m-35-07.thinking.2: Nemo sharadin da ya ɓace (alamar ƙididdigar farko) sannan gyara amsar
y-m-35-07.prereq.0: Siffar jadawalin aikin murabba’i y = ax² + bx + c da determinant D = b² − 4ac
y-m-35-07.prereq.1: Babban ra’ayin sharadin da zai sa rashin daidaiton ax² + bx + c > 0 ya cika ga duk lambobin gaske (dangantakar matsayin jadawalin da x-axis)
y-m-35-07.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa don tantance mafita biyun?
y-m-35-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi k = −3 daga kewayon A, saka shi da x = 0 cikin kx² − 4x + k, sannan ka bincika ko ƙimar tabbatacciya ce.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko jadawalin yana sama ko ƙasa da x-axis idan k = 3 da kuma idan k = −3.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.a: A daidai ne — idan D < 0, jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis, saboda haka sharadin yana cika kullum
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.a: Ya ɗauki rashin haɗuwa da x-axis da kasancewa “sama” da x-axis a matsayin abu ɗaya.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.b: A da B duk ba daidai ba ne — ba su bincika yanayin k = 0 ko D = 0 dabam ba
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.b: An riga an cire k = 0 da D = 0 daga amsar. Idan ka bincika, babu ɗayansu da ya cika sharadin.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.c: B daidai ne — ban da D < 0, ana buƙatar sharadin alkiblar jadawali (alamar k)
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.d: A da B duk daidai ne — sun samo kewayo ɗaya ta hanyoyi daban-daban
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.d: Ba a lura cewa amsoshin A da B sun bambanta ba.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.explain: Idan D < 0, jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis, amma idan k < 0, jadawalin yana ƙasa da x-axis gaba ɗaya, don haka kx² − 4x + k > 0 ba ya cika. Saboda haka ana kuma buƙatar k > 0, kuma amsar ita ce k > 2. (Idan k = 2, to D = 0 kuma ƙimar tana 0 idan x = 1, saboda haka ba a yarda da shi ba.)
y-m-35-07.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri misalin da zai ƙaryata ta: k da ke cikin kewayon A (k > 2 ko k < −2) amma sharadin tambayar bai cika ba. Ƙirƙiri (k, x) biyu masu k daban-daban inda k < −2 kuma kx² − 4x + k ≤ 0.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi k guda daga kewayon A, kamar −3, ka ƙididdige ƙimar furucin yayin da kake canja x zuwa 0, 1, 2.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.hint.1: Idan akwai ko da x guda da ƙimar furuci ta zama 0 ko ƙasa da haka, wannan (k, x) misalin ƙaryatawa ne. Yanayin da ƙimar ta tabbata ba misalin ƙaryatawa ba ne.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.fail.c1: k ba ya cikin kewayon A (k < −2).
y-m-35-07.s.s2.ok.c2: A wannan x, ƙimar furucin 0 ce ko ƙasa da haka, don haka sharadin ya karye.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan x, ƙimar furucin tabbatacciya ce. Gwada wani x.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.explain: Idan k < 0, ƙimar furucin idan x = 0 ita ce k, saboda haka tuni mara kyau ce. Misali, (−3, 0) yana ba da −3, (−4, 1) yana ba da −12, kuma (−5, 2) yana ba da −33. Misalin ƙaryatawa guda ɗaya na iya nuna cewa kewayon A ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.prompt: A cikin jimla ɗaya ko biyu, rubuta abin da ya ɓace a mafitar A, sannan kammala kewayon k da zai sa “kx² − 4x + k > 0 ga duk lambobin gaske x”.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.hint.0: Canja k zuwa −3, 0, 3 ka bincika da kanka ko jadawalin yana sama da x-axis.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta dabam abin da mafitar A ta bincika (jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis) da abin da ba ta bincika ba tukuna (ko yana sama ko ƙasa da x-axis).
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka saka wata ƙimar k daga kewayon da ka rubuta (misali 3) don tabbatar da cewa kullum tana tabbatacciya?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta cewa sanin D < 0 yana nufin “jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis” kawai?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bincika dalilin da ya sa k = 2 ba ya aiki?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.model.0: A ta duba determinant kaɗai, ba ta duba alamar k ba. Idan k < 0, jadawalin yana buɗewa ƙasa, ba sama ba, saboda haka yana ƙasa da x-axis kuma koyaushe marar kyau ne. Don haka ana buƙatar k > 0, kuma amsar ita ce k > 2.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.model.1: D < 0 yana nufin kawai cewa jadawalin ba ya haɗuwa da x-axis; alamar ƙididdigar farko k ce ke yanke ko yana sama ko ƙasa da x-axis. Don ya fi 0 ga duk x, ana buƙatar k > 0, saboda haka haɗa shi da k² > 4 yana ba da k > 2.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta mayar da hankali kan rawar ƙididdigar farko
